title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
abstract: Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer's feedback into detailed plans. The Builder turns these plans into candidate games. The coding-native Player creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to efficiently collect diverse gameplay trajectories, mitigating evaluation bias caused by slow GUI-based collection. The Reviewer uses carefully designed trajectory-based metrics to induce player preferences, integrating with visual evidence and explicit textual preferences to evaluate games against game-specific criteria. Finally, the Reviewer accepts the better version and provides improvement reviews for the next round, closing the recursive loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art overall performance of 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench. On GameASG-Bench, it achieves a strict task success rate of 53.2%, a 34.1% improvement over the same-model baseline, and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate at 93.4% among compared methods. A user study shows longer playtime and higher ratings. Code is coming soon.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In Agentic Software Development, we’ve seen systems such as Harness-of-Harness coordinate coding agents through repeated planning and testing, while GameCraft-Bench asks whether agents can build complete playable games. Today's lecture is on Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness. Developed by researchers including members of HKU MMLab at the University of Hong Kong, this paper asks how generated games can be refined for player experience, not merely made runnable. I see a hand—go ahead, Noah.
segments.zh: 在智能体软件开发领域，我们已经看到像Harness-of-Harness这样的系统通过反复规划和测试来协调编程智能体，而GameCraft-Bench则在追问智能体能否构建出完整可玩的游戏。今天的讲座讲的是递归游戏创作器：一个面向智能体产品级体验的游戏框架。这篇论文由香港大学HKU MMLab等机构的研究者开发，探讨的是如何让生成的游戏在玩家体验层面得到打磨，而不仅仅是能跑起来。我看到有人举手——请讲，Noah。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, are you saying that a game can pass its technical checks and still fail as a player experience?
segments.zh: 教授，您的意思是，一款游戏就算通过了技术检查，在玩家体验上还是可能不合格吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. A game may launch, respond to inputs, and satisfy a specification, yet still have confusing controls, poor pacing, or little reason to keep playing. Recursive Game Creator, or R-G-C, makes experience an explicit target of development. It connects implementation with repeated play, behavioral and visual assessment, preference feedback, and version selection. The central idea is to treat game creation not as a single act of code generation, but as a cycle in which evidence from play helps guide the next revision.
segments.zh: 没错。一款游戏也许能启动、能响应输入、能满足规格要求，但操作依然让人摸不着头脑，节奏糟糕，或者根本没什么理由让人继续玩下去。递归游戏创作器，也就是R-G-C，把体验变成了开发中一个明确的目标。它把实现与反复试玩、行为与视觉评估、偏好反馈以及版本选择连接起来。核心思路是，不把游戏创作当成一次性的代码生成行为，而是当成一个循环——在这个循环里，来自试玩的证据会帮助指导下一轮修改。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The cycle has four roles: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer turns the user’s brief and earlier feedback into a plan, including changes to make, features to preserve, and acceptance goals. Those goals connect broad aims to observable outcomes, such as a scene, a player input, and the expected result. The Builder implements the plan in stages, first creating a playable draft and then integrating requested assets while checking how they work with animation, collision, and interaction.
segments.zh: 这个循环包含四个角色：设计师、构建者、玩家和评审者。设计师把用户的简要需求和之前的反馈转化成一份计划，包括要做哪些改动、保留哪些功能，以及验收目标。这些目标把宽泛的意图和可观察的结果连接起来，比如一个场景、一次玩家输入，以及预期的结果。构建者分阶段实现这份计划，先做出一个可玩的草稿，然后整合所需的素材，同时检查它们在动画、碰撞和交互方面是否正常。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: what makes this Player different from an agent that just looks at screenshots and presses buttons?
segments.zh: 问个简单的问题：这个玩家和一个只看截图、按按钮的智能体有什么不同？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: R-G-C’s Player is coding-native: it reads the game’s state schema and available actions, then writes executable policies that interact through the game’s programmatic interface. A policy might pursue quick completion, while another explores optional areas or takes fewer risks. The system can run these policies repeatedly, recording observations, actions, events, progress, elapsed time, and outcomes. Screenshots or recordings can also be reviewed, but visual interpretation is kept separate from the frequent control loop.
segments.zh: R-G-C 的 Player 是代码原生的：它会读取游戏的状态模式和可用动作，然后编写可执行的策略，通过游戏的编程接口进行交互。一个策略可能追求快速通关，而另一个则探索可选区域或减少冒险。系统可以反复运行这些策略，记录观察结果、动作、事件、进度、耗时和结果。截图或录像也可以被审查，但视觉解读与高频控制循环是分开的。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: This separation is meant to make playtesting more reusable. Instead of asking an agent to interpret every new image and choose each action from scratch, the system creates a policy and executes it across trials or separate game instances. The resulting trajectories give the Reviewer structured evidence about what happened and where progress stopped. Policy creation, repair, execution, and review still have costs, though; the approach does not make evaluation free. It changes how tests are gathered and organized.
segments.zh: 这种分离是为了让游戏测试更具复用性。系统不再要求智能体每看到一张新图像就重新理解、每做一个动作都从零开始，而是先创建一个策略，再把它放到多次试验或不同的游戏实例中执行。由此产生的轨迹为评审器提供了结构化证据，说明发生了什么、进展在哪里停滞。不过，策略的创建、修复、执行和评审仍然有成本；这种方法并没有让评估变得免费，它改变的是测试的收集和组织方式。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So how does the Reviewer decide whether a game is actually improving, rather than just producing more successful runs?
segments.zh: 那么，评审器如何判断一款游戏是真的在进步，而不只是产生了更多成功的运行结果呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It interprets shared signals such as success rate and playtime alongside progress and reasons for stopping. A high success rate could mean a game is too easy, while repeated failure could suggest frustration; long sessions might indicate exploration, or simply being stuck. The Reviewer also uses game-specific criteria. For a racing game, it might assess steering response and collision feedback; for a visual novel, dialogue coherence and whether choices feel consequential.
segments.zh: 它会综合解读成功率、游玩时长这些共享信号，同时结合进度和停止原因来判断。成功率高可能说明游戏太简单，而反复失败则可能意味着玩家感到挫败；长时间游玩可能是在探索，也可能只是卡住了。评审器还会采用针对具体游戏类型的标准。比如赛车游戏，它会评估转向响应和碰撞反馈；视觉小说则看对话是否连贯，以及选择是否让人觉得有分量。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify how user preferences become part of the next version?
segments.zh: 你能说明一下用户偏好是怎么进入下一个版本的吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The Reviewer turns its findings into a structured preference record: the experience being sought, supporting evidence, whether the preference was explicitly stated or inferred from play, and priorities for revision. It then compares the new candidate with the retained version using shared signals and game-specific criteria. The outcome can favor either version, call them tied, or leave the judgment unavailable. The selected version is kept, and the next Designer plan draws on the review, closing the loop.
segments.zh: 评审器会把它的发现整理成一份结构化的偏好记录：想要追求什么样的体验、有哪些证据支撑、这条偏好是玩家明确说出来的还是从游玩中推断出来的，以及修改的优先级。接着，它用共享信号和针对具体游戏的标准，把新候选版本和保留版本做对比。结果可能是偏向其中任一版本，也可能判定两者持平，或者干脆给不出判断。被选中的版本会保留下来，下一轮设计师计划再参考这份评审，从而形成闭环。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The evaluation shows gains on two benchmarks, but the results need careful interpretation. On GameCraft-Bench, R-G-C rises from 72.70 after its first refinement round to 77.89 after its third, compared with 71.26 for the same-model baseline. All five reported categories improve between those rounds, with Action rising by 9.66 points. The paper suggests that action games may need several rounds to coordinate controls, combat feedback, and progression, but the scores alone do not prove why.
segments.zh: 评估显示在两个基准上都有提升，但结果需要谨慎解读。在GameCraft-Bench上，R-G-C从第一轮优化后的72.70提升到第三轮后的77.89，而同模型基线为71.26。在这两轮之间，报告的全部五个类别均有提升，其中Action提升了9.66分。论文认为动作游戏可能需要多轮来协调操作、战斗反馈和进度推进，但仅凭分数无法证明原因。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: On GameASG-Bench, R-G-C passes 25 of 47 tasks, or 53.2%, compared with 9 of 47 for the same-model G-P-T six Astra high baseline. Its mean runtime-check pass rate is 93.4%. But a different-model G-P-T six Astra ultra baseline passes 26 tasks, slightly more than R-G-C, so it would be inaccurate to claim the best task-success result across every entry. A spatial example also shows 48 policy rollouts covering 97.1% of a test map, including 11 interiors.
segments.zh: 在GameASG-Bench上，R-G-C通过了47个任务中的25个，也就是53.2%，而同模型G-P-T six Astra high基线的通过数是47个中的9个。它的平均运行时检查通过率是93.4%。但另一个不同模型的G-P-T six Astra ultra基线通过了26个任务，略多于R-G-C，所以说R-G-C在所有条目中取得了最佳任务成功率是不准确的。一个空间示例还显示，48条策略轨迹覆盖了测试地图的97.1%，其中包括11个室内区域。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does that map coverage establish that coding-native testing is faster or more representative than ordinary playtesting?
segments.zh: 这种地图覆盖率能证明代码原生测试比普通试玩测试更快或更有代表性吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The coverage example illustrates what the policies can explore; it is not a controlled speed comparison with graphical-interface play. Expert ratings also rise between the first and third rounds: controls move from 2 to 8, playability from 1 to 7, depth from 3 to 6, and art from 2 to 8 on a 1-to-10 scale. Average playtime increases from 1.50 to 12.41 minutes, but the supplied paper text does not report the study’s sample size or statistical uncertainty.
segments.zh: 不能。覆盖率的例子只是说明这些策略能探索什么，并不是与图形界面游玩进行的受控速度对比。专家评分在第一轮到第三轮之间也有所上升：在1到10分的量表上，操控性从2升到8，可玩性从1升到7，深度从3升到6，美术从2升到8。平均游玩时长从1.50分钟增加到12.41分钟，但提供的论文文本没有报告该研究的样本量或统计不确定性。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader implication is a shift from checking whether generated software runs toward asking what happens when someone—or a test policy—uses it. This connects to Harness-of-Harness’s repeated development and testing, while R-G-C specializes that cycle around game experience and player evidence. Its reusable policies are valuable when a game exposes state and actions programmatically. But those interfaces may not reflect ordinary human play, and policy strategies cannot stand in for the full range of player responses.
segments.zh: 更广泛的含义是，重心正从检查生成的软件能否运行，转向追问当有人——或者一个测试策略——去使用它时会发生什么。这与 Harness-of-Harness 反复进行的开发和测试一脉相承，而 R-G-C 则把这一循环专门聚焦到游戏体验和玩家证据上。当一款游戏能以编程方式暴露状态和动作时，它那些可复用的策略就很有价值。但这些接口未必能反映普通人的真实游玩方式，而策略也无法替代玩家反应的全部范围。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How should future work address the gap between inferred preferences and what players actually enjoy?
segments.zh: 未来的研究该如何弥合推断出的偏好与玩家真正喜欢的体验之间的差距？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A natural next step is to validate inferred preferences with human playtests, then examine whether those preferences predict satisfaction across different player groups and game types. Success rates and time spent are useful clues, not direct measures of enjoyment; a person may play longer because they are engaged or because they are lost. The same caution applies to benchmark gains: they support progress within the reported settings, but do not establish generalization across engines, populations, or development workflows.
segments.zh: 一个自然的下一步，是用真人试玩来验证推断出的偏好，然后考察这些偏好能否预测不同玩家群体和游戏类型下的满意度。成功率和游玩时长是有用的线索，但并不是对乐趣的直接衡量；一个人玩得更久，可能是因为投入，也可能是因为迷失了方向。同样的谨慎也适用于基准提升：它们支持在报告设定内的进展，但并不能确立跨引擎、跨人群或跨开发流程的泛化能力。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The lasting lesson is that experience-oriented game generation needs more than a capable Builder. It needs a way to play, record what happened, interpret that evidence in context, and decide which revision to keep. R-G-C offers one structured approach, with coding-native policies as a practical source of repeatable behavioral evidence and human testing as an essential complement. A playable artifact is a beginning, not a verdict on quality. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our A-I assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 持久的教训是，面向体验的游戏生成不只需要一个能干的构建器，还需要一种方式来游玩、记录发生了什么、结合语境解读这些证据，并决定保留哪一版修改。R-G-C 提供了一种结构化的方法，把编码原生的策略作为可重复行为证据的实用来源，并把人工测试作为必不可少的补充。一个可玩的产物只是开始，并不是对质量的最终裁决。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
